verdict.rationale: Datalab documents webhooks that notify you when document processing jobs complete, which implies an async job model. A default webhook URL can be overridden per request with the webhook_url parameter, which fits a non-blocking pipeline. Status polling is only implied by the docs saying webhooks eliminate 'the need for continuous polling'. missing for 10: an explicitly documented async job-submission flow with a request/job ID, a documented status-polling endpoint, webhook payload/retry/signing details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
Configure webhooks to receive real-time notifications when Datalab jobs complete.
You can override the default webhook URL for specific API requests by including the webhook_url parameter
